title: Motor Thermal Shutdown
shortDescription: Thermal protector cut power to motor.
fullDescription:
Hoover uprights and canisters include a thermal protector that trips when airflow is blocked.

Allow 30-45 minutes cool-down before restart.
whenToCallPro: If does not restart after cooldown.

title: Brush Roll Stalled
fullDescription: Hoover brush rolls lock up when hair or large debris wraps around the bearings. Some models turn off brush motor to prevent burn.

title: Drive Belt Broken
shortDescription: Brush belt snapped or jumped off.
fullDescription: Classic Hoover uprights rely on a rubber belt; breakage is common and easy to fix.

fixSteps.title: Install new belt
fixSteps.instruction: Stretch belt onto motor shaft and brush.

title: Hose or Wand Blockage
fullDescription: A sudden loss of suction usually indicates an obstruction in hose, wand, or inlet.

title: Filter Needs Cleaning
fullDescription: A clogged filter is the leading cause of suction loss on bagless Hoovers.

fixSteps.title: Tap HEPA
fixSteps.instruction: Tap dust out or rinse if model allows.

title: Cord Rewind Jam
fullDescription: Elite Rewind and Air models include a spring-loaded reel; debris or a stuck spring prevents retraction.

fixSteps.title: Untangle cord
fixSteps.instruction: Pull entire cord out, feed back in straight.

title: Power Switch Failure
fullDescription: Rocker switch contacts oxidize over years and fail.

title: ONEPWR Battery Low
fullDescription: Hoover ONEPWR platform packs blink when discharged; place on charger until indicator goes solid.

fixSteps.title: Replace pack
fixSteps.instruction: If runtime short, buy new ONEPWR pack.
